content: Written 2026-10-07 07:10, self-approved once the P1 version is chosen (queue22.sh <commit>). Real row 4 v5 = real row 4 v4's code (9e50f83: R2, A1, F2, G8) + M1 (82558fe) + P1 in the chosen version (P1c baf1cd3 preferred: tau = sigma(q); P1b 6533acc: tau 5 cm) WITHOUT M2 (supervisor: real data fits the GPU, v4 peaked at 8.8 GB; so row 4 differs from rows 1/3 only by P1, M1 being numerically equal); with P1c the commit is 05cb1bf (= baf1cd3 + M2 reverted (0a56159) + the F2 catch of RuntimeError in the end-of-run step, so pre_ref is always complete and the error is recorded in run.json). Flags as v4: --backend game --row 4 --core l2 --d1 --g5 --inside --g5-reference render --g8-holdout, GAME_CONFIG flat.yaml. Only row 4 changes; rows 1/3 (9e50f83) stay.

Before GaME seeds a keyframe at t: memory Gaussians (built before the session, alive at t) that the keyframe observes (centre in the image with measured depth d, z <= d + tau) end at t (death_evidence); GaME's own seeding then builds the session's surface there (alpha < 0.3 / depth error / colour error, GaME game.py:545-590). Sources: TSDF session_refusion.cpp (the present re-fused from the session's frames) and README sec. 6 assembly order (present first, memory only fills what the session did not observe). P1c: tau = sigma(q) of the previous session's P37 table; session_refusion's memory test uses tau = max(h, sigma(q)), h = 0 assumed (3DGS has no voxel grid). Item 2 of the hard goal follows: memory observed by the session is not supervised by its keyframes any more; old keyframes supervise only the map of their time (T1).

The map of time t: a memory Gaussian lives until the first keyframe of a later session that observes its place; that keyframe and every later one render the session's own Gaussians there. Earlier keyframes still render (and train) it (history, 4D). Nothing is deleted.

z, d in GaME scene units (metres x 10); q = |camera-to-centre| / 10 in metres; sigma per RANGE_BIN 0.5 m (session_end.RANGE_BIN), the lookup of session_end.memory_test; tau x 10 in scene units. P37 table of the previous session (real A's: 1.41 ... 3.72 cm).

eval_row.sh unchanged (G1 surfel + median, G2, D2/D3, ghost, retention + retention_correct, Object F1 Table 1, D1 (main: processed frames), G8 render metrics final model + own_time), post_ref view for C; compared with real_row1v3 / real_row3v3 / real_row4v4 in compare_rows (same protocol 9e50f83 + M1/P1).

OUT/real_row4v5: per session timeline.pkl and checkpoint (keyframe-stripped after the evaluation), C post_ref (deleted after its evaluation, restorable), eval_real and post_ref/eval_real, run.json with 'P1: N memory Gaussian ends' in the log.

The P1 comparison smokes (real A->B 300 frames, full eval chain: smoke_p1_real, smoke_p1b_real, smoke_ctl_real, smoke_p1c_real) run the P1 code path through the whole evaluation; the chosen version's smoke is its smoke.

~1 h 40 mapping + C refinement ~16-25 min + evaluation ~1 h (pre + post); GPU ~9 GB mapping peak (v4: 8.8 GB), alone on the card; disk +~50 GB at the end of mapping, ~18 GB kept after cleanup (used inside 317 GB at 05:41).

As records 'PRE-RUN CRITERIA, hard-goal item 1': B and C 'behind' precision share and observed-but-missing recall share near row 1's (C behind < 1.5 %, observed < 3 %); G1 P and R (surfel and median) >= max(row 1, row 3) in B and C; G8 >= rows 1/3; unobserved retention, correct-surface retention, D2/D3, ghost, object F1 not worse than v4 (the C object-F1 interval of I10 excepted: user decision). Refuted if P or R does not rise by >= 1 pp in B and C or any other gets worse: then P1 is reverted for row 4 (v4 stays).
M2 (43f1bde, reverted in 0a56159) is used only for a synthetic row 4 whose refinement hits GPU memory, and only after analysis/scripts/m2_check.py passes (identities equal, label sums allclose).
queue22 runs them with 05cb1bf: without the layer P1 cannot act (no T1, no noise table), so it is 82558fe + the F2 catch.
